Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You lay a warm hand over a cramped muscle and feel it loosen beneath your fingers.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing living creature.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires one free hand; grants no item.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Reduce temporary Slowed by 1, minimum 0. This restores no HP and does not repair a wound, replace a limb or remove a starred condition.
